cases.requirement: Deep links and saved runs preserve safe session ownership.

cases.requirement: Readable cinematic workspace with truthful, accessible approval feedback
cases.preconditions: Synthetic run with current assessed evidence; desktop/mobile and reduced-motion browser preference
steps: Review the lined script and exception cards; follow a beat to its evidence.
Request wrap as 1st AD; read the current package SHA-256 fingerprint.
Approve; wait for returned server state before expecting a saved confirmation.
Repeat with reduced motion; inspect viewport and approval evidence.
cases.expected_outcome: Continuity/coverage accents retain text labels; server-confirmed wrap state alone controls the checkmark; displayed digest equals API package_revision_digest. No Merkle proof or legal-clearance claim. Reduced-motion removes decorative animation.
cases.negative_recovery_case: A failed click or a successful action without refreshed state does not claim a saved wrap. Changed server state removes confirmation. Existing stale-evidence approval refusal remains enforced.
cases.automation_mapping: tests/components.test.tsx (server-state-only confirmation and status accents); tests/e2e/journeys.spec.ts LT03 (exact API fingerprint, saved feedback, reduced motion and viewport); tests/contracts.test.mjs
cases.observed_result_evidence: Run-specific automated outcome is recorded in the frontend-ci and main release Live Playwright testbook artifacts. Earlier checkpoints in this document predate this UI case and are not evidence for it.
